Privacy policy

Puerto Plata Cruise Excursions runs shore excursions in Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic, for cruise passengers. This page explains what personal data we use when you book, why, and who it is shared with. If you have questions, message us on WhatsApp at +1 (829) 627-7733 or email popcruiseexcursions@gmail.com.

What we ask for

The booking form asks for the tour, the date, how many people, your name and, if you like, the name of your cruise ship, plus the tour options (zipline, boat, vehicle or transport). We only ask for what we need to organize your tour and get you back to your ship on time.

How your booking reaches us

The form does not send anything on its own. “Book on WhatsApp” opens WhatsApp with your booking already written, and you choose to send it; “Book by email” opens your email app with a message to popcruiseexcursions@gmail.com. Your booking then stays in our WhatsApp chat (a Meta service) or in our email (a Gmail account, by Google), which are also subject to those services’ policies.

What we use it for

We use your data only to confirm availability, organize the tour, arrange the meeting point and time around your ship, and handle your deposit, the remaining payment and any cancellation or refund. We don’t sell it or use it for advertising.

Payments

Deposits are paid by PayPal, Zelle or Cash App, and the rest in person on the day of the tour. Each payment service handles your payment details under its own privacy policy; we never see or store your card details.

What your browser keeps

The site uses no cookies, no analytics and no advertising. If you choose a language, your browser remembers it (local storage) to show you the site in that language next time; you can clear it in your browser settings. Fonts, images and videos are served from our own site.

Where the site is hosted

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., United States). Like any web server, GitHub logs technical data about each visit, such as the IP address, to keep the service secure.

How long

We keep your booking messages for as long as we need them to run your tour and meet our accounting and legal obligations.

Your rights

You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data by messaging us on WhatsApp or by email. We will answer as soon as possible, under the applicable law (in the Dominican Republic, Law 172-13 on personal data protection; if you visit from the European Union, the General Data Protection Regulation).

Last updated: November 22, 2026.
